sections.title: Pickup and return
paragraphs: Handover is available at the office (Immeuble Sinwan, ground floor, Agadir 80000), Agadir-Al Massira Airport (AGA), hotel or city centre by arrangement.
Vehicle condition is checked at pickup and return. Report any existing damage immediately at handover.

sections.title: Fuel, care and use
paragraphs: Unless stated otherwise, fuel policy is full-to-full. Return the car in reasonable cleanliness.
Personal/tourist use only. No subletting, no leaving Morocco without written approval, and no use outside agreed conditions.

sections.title: Assistance and cancellation
paragraphs: 24/7 WhatsApp assistance is available for rental emergencies.
Cancellation or change rules depend on timing and vehicle; they are confirmed at booking.

privacy.intro: AmseelCars processes personal data to handle rental requests, improve the website and meet legal duties. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.title: Data we collect
paragraphs: Contact details from forms or WhatsApp: name, email, phone, rental dates, vehicle preferences and messages.
Technical browsing data (pages, device, language) via analytics tools when enabled.

sections.title: Purposes
paragraphs: Process bookings and contact requests, provide customer follow-up, reduce spam/fraud, and analyse site usage.
Transactional emails related to a booking may be sent via our email provider (Resend).

sections.title: Legal basis and retention
paragraphs: Processing is based on your request (pre-contract steps), our legitimate interest in securing the service, and consent where required for certain cookies/measurement.
We keep data only as long as needed for the commercial relationship and legal obligations, then delete or anonymise it.

sections.title: Sharing and security
paragraphs: Access is limited to the AmseelCars team and necessary technical providers (hosting, email, maps, admin auth).
We apply reasonable security measures. Contact us if you have concerns.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion or restriction of processing.
Contact: amseelcars5@gmail.com or WhatsApp +212 662 500 181. Address: Immeuble Sinwan, ground floor, Agadir 80000, Morocco.

sections.title: Publisher
paragraphs: AmseelCars — car rental agency in Agadir, Morocco.
Address: Immeuble Sinwan, ground floor, Agadir 80000, Morocco. Phone / WhatsApp: +212 662 500 181. Email: amseelcars5@gmail.com.

sections.title: Activity
paragraphs: Vehicle rental for travellers: city, Agadir-Al Massira Airport (AGA) and nearby areas such as Taghazout, subject to availability.
Open 24/7 for arranged handovers by appointment.

sections.title: Hosting
paragraphs: The site is hosted on cloud infrastructure (e.g. Vercel and related services). Content data may be stored in a cloud database depending on configuration.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: AmseelCars texts, visuals and brand assets are protected. Unauthorised reproduction is prohibited.
Car brand names belong to their respective owners and are used to describe the rental fleet.
